Statement: The support-desk system has agents as the primary actor and contains a web UI + analytics database, sitting inside the corporate intranet boundary.
Agents authenticate via the corporate SSO gateway; the web UI uses the analytics database for reporting.
Ticket flow starts with an intake event, then routes through a severity-assignment task; high-severity tickets follow the page-on-call sequence flow.
The severity-assignment task ALWAYS runs within one hour; the page-on-call flow ALWAYS triggers for High or Critical severity.
